title_zh: 给 AI 打零工的人，和给 AI 造工具的人
title_en: Those Who Gig for AI, and Those Who Build for AI
desc_zh: AI 正在把工作拆成两层生意：一端是给 AI 打零工的人，另一端是给 AI 造工具的人；夹在中间的真人溢价在涨价——一位 CEO 开价 13 万美元雇人扮演自己。
desc_en: AI is splitting work into two businesses: gig workers who train AI, and builders who make AI tools — while the premium on real human presence keeps rising.
